chunks: Muhammad ibn Ibrahim ibn Ishaq al-Talaqani and al-Hasan ibn Abdullah ibn Sa'id al-'Askari narrated to us together. They said: 'Abd al-'Aziz ibn Yahya al-Juludi narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn Zakariyya al-Jawhari narrated to us. Ali ibn Hakim narrated to me, from al-Rabi' ibn Abdullah, from Abdullah ibn al-Hasan, from Zayd ibn Ali, from his father (peace be upon him), who said:
God, the Mighty and Majestic, says: If a creature of Mine who recognizes Me disobeys Me, I will make one who does not recognize Me rule over him.

key_terms.سلطت: I will make rule / give authority over -- divine empowerment of an oppressor as punishment
key_terms.عصاني: Disobeys Me -- the act of rebellion against divine commands despite knowing God
key_terms.يعرفني: Recognizes Me / knows Me -- refers to ma'rifah (spiritual knowledge of God)

ai.seo_question: What is the divine consequence of disobeying God while knowing Him according to Imam Zayn al-Abidin?
ai.summary: In this hadith qudsi (divine saying), Imam Zayn al-Abidin (AS) relates that God declares a principle of divine governance: when a person who possesses knowledge of God (ma'rifah) disobeys Him, God punishes them by placing over them one who does not know Him at all. This was addressed to early Muslim audiences as a warning that knowledge without obedience leads to subjugation under unjust rulers, reflecting the Shia understanding that political oppression results from the community's disobedience to divine authority.

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. Ibrahim b. Ishaq al-Talaqani and al-Hasan b. `Abdullah b. Sa`id al-`Askari narrated to us together. They said: `Abd al-`Aziz b. Yahya al-Juludi narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Zakariyya al-Jawhari narrated to us. `Ali b. al-Hakim narrated to me from al-Rabi` b. `Abdullah from `Abdullah b. al-Hasan from Zayd b. `Ali from his father (as).  He said:
Allah says: If a creature of mine who recognizes Me disobeys Me, I will make one who does not recognize Me rule over him.
